translation: Flavor sweet, greatly cold, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel the exuberance of seasonal (epidemic) heat, the latent heat (伏熱) of the five viscera, heat within the stomach, vexation and fullness, stop thirst, (treat) edema, and [pain in] the lower abdomen. One name is 寒水石 (cold-water stone), one name is 凌水石; colored like mica, that which can be split well is fine; salt [of it] ...
translator_notes: The passage is partly garbled; 鹽之 possibly refers to processing with salt. Sentence truncated.
